notes.title: New Release: Defy Gravity Extended
notes.content:
Defy Gravity Extended is Now Available and is 10% off until August 1st 5PM PST.

Kara, our heroine, has access to a unique gameplay mechanic that she uses to manipulate the world around her. She has a gun that is able to alter the laws of physics through the creation of pockets of gravity and anti-gravity. By mastering the use of these abilities Kara is able to augment her jump in order to almost fly past obstacles.
